Resolves #19510

The split chapter's opening and its *Thirty-one minutes* note now claim only what was measured. The opening compares GitHub's 5.21 GiB of storage on August 19 with GitHub's own 243 MiB today, and gives the 252 MiB pack as what a fresh clone downloads. The note says the existing Fleet Manager source was ported into a layout written first: the first commit brought 134 files, and the third ran the app. Both bounds come from Euclid's review of the split post, and the wording matches Grace's repair at #19508.

Evidence: L1 (two prose passages; each figure re-read at its primary on 2026-10-09) → L1 required. No residual.

Micro-review eligible: documentation. One notes file, 2+/2−, two corrected claims.
